sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Physical Grocery Store Retailing of Imported Asian Condiments and Veg

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid — Civil Law codification under the Código de Comercio with substantial Common Law-inspired corporate and trust jurisprudence
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: United States–Panama Trade Promotion Agreement (TPA, in force 2012)
United Kingdom–Panama Double Taxation Agreement (in force 2014)
Netherlands–Panama Tax Arrangement for the Avoidance of Double Taxation (REDI framework)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (AML/CFT) as amended by Ley 70 de 2019; Decreto Ejecutivo 160 de 2019 (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales and UBO duties); UAF regulatory resolutions; Ley 32 de 1927 (Corporate Law, registered agent obligations); SBP licensing rules for corporate service providers.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified notarial copy of legal representative's and directors' passport/ID pages
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public / Apostille Office of country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized general or special Power of Attorney granted to the Panamanian resident agent/incorporator attorney
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in country of origin (or Panamanian Notary if executed domestically)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or domestic notarization if signed in Panama)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency / Certificate of Good Standing of foreign corporate incorporator (if any)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official Companies Registry of the foreign jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization (non-Hague jurisdictions)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening under Ley 23 de 2015 (as amended): consultation of OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council sanctions, EU restrictive measures, INTERPOL notices and UAF/domestic PEP database; implementation of a written KYC policy; identification of domestic and international PEPs (including family members and close associates) with enhanced due diligence (EDD) applied before any engagement.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá – Sistema de Información del Registro Público (SIRP), online 'Certificado de Nombre' consultation module
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be submitted in Spanish formal style using Latin script; statutory abbreviations (S.A., Inc., Corp.) are permitted; non-Spanish trading names may be entered as transliterated secondary names, but the full legal name must conform to Panamanian registry conventions; names implying connection to public authorities, foreign states, or regulated financial activity require prior ministerial or supervisory authorization.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant's licensed attorney files a sworn administrative reconsideration request (recurso de reconsideración) with the Dirección General del Registro Público within the statutory appeal term, attaching the certificate of denial and supporting trademark or prior-use evidence; if denied again, an administrative appeal (recurso de apelación) proceeds to the Pleno of the Registro Público, followed by a judicial annulment action before the Sala Tercera de lo Contencioso-Administrativo of the Corte Suprema de Justicia. A fresh name search under a variant spelling may simultaneously be submitted to avoid operational delay.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A licensed resident agent's address satisfies the statutory registered office requirement, and a serviced virtual office is accepted for the corporate register; however, the municipal Aviso de Operación and MINSA food-trade permits require a physical, inspector-accessible commercial premises for the Asian supermarket, so a purely virtual mailbox is not permissible for the operating license.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High (approximately 80%) risk of unannounced on-site inspections by MINSA health inspectors and municipal fiscal authorities within the first 12 months of food retail operations; recurring sanitary inspections are semi-annual for food establishments.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registry name clearance certificate (certificado de nombre) for 'ASIAN SUPERMARKET GROCERY HUB'
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registry tariff (price list of the Dirección General del Registro)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille / consular legalization of origin notarial bundle (passport copies, power of attorney, incumbency certificates)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory service fee per apostilled or legalized document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Incorporation drafting and public deed execution before a Panamanian notary

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for standard S.A. incorporation with bylaws and officer appointments

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registration (inscripción) of the Sociedad Anónima in the Public Registry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff based on nominal authorized capital (capital for incorporation purposes)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Resident agent (agente residente) first annual service fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for registered office and statutory representation services

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Biennial franchise tax (impuesto de canon/fichero) pre-payment to the National Treasury
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) — Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Municipal Aviso de Operación application for grocery retail (patente comercial)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Municipal tariff as a function of declared investment and business classification (retail food trade)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: MINSA sanitary permit for food retail establishment (certificado sanitario)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministerio de Salud (MINSA) — Departamento de Saneamiento Ambiental
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory health regulation fee for retail food sales area

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Beneficial Owner (UBO) registry initial filing and KYC/PEP/OFAC screening execution by resident agent

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for compliance preparation of the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley No. 32 de 26 de febrero de 1927 (Ley General de Sociedades Anónimas), as amended by Ley No. 5 de 2015 and complementary regulations including Executive Decree No. 63 of 2015; Código de Comercio de Panamá (Book II, corporate provisions); Law 41 of 1998 for environmental framework; Civil Code provisions on contracts and obligations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá (Panama Public Registry) - Sección de Registro Mercantil / Departamento de Personas Jurídicas
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución de Sociedad Anónima (Public Deed of Incorporation) - Pacto Social and Estatutos
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is required by Panama law. The Articles commonly authorize a nominal capital of US$10,000 represented by 100 common shares of US$100.00 par value; subscribed capital may remain partly paid at incorporation. No escrow account, bank deposit certificate, or government capital proof is required for the S.A. formation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: That the share subscription presented at this first meeting of the Board of Directors is approved, and issuance of registered shares to the subscribers is authorized upon payment of the agreed consideration. RESOLVED FURTHER: That the registered office of the Company is fixed at the address recorded in these minutes, which shall be the principal statutory seat, and the Corporate Secretary is instructed to file such address with the Public Registry and the Municipality. RESOLVED FURTHER: That the persons named in these minutes are appointed President, Secretary and Treasurer, each to serve until a successor is elected. RESOLVED FURTHER: That the appointed officers are jointly empowered to open bank accounts, sign commercial documents and take all lawful steps to commence operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of the Public Deed (Escritura Pública) of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública de la República de Panamá (qualified Panamanian notary, First Judicial District, Panama City)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the draft Pacto Social and Estatutos in Spanish pursuant to Law 32 of 1927, specifying the corporate name, authorized capital, share classes, directors, registered agent, and registered office. The incorporators must appear personally before the notary, evidence identity with valid passports, and execute the deed. Pay the municipal stamp tax on the document and obtain the notary's certified first testimonio for subsequent registration.
required_dossiers: Draft Pacto Social / Estatutos in Spanish
Valid passports (or cédulas) of the subscribing incorporators (minimum two)
Registered agent acceptance letter confirming the Panama City agency office
Registered office address details and landlord name if leased
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary requests textual corrections, amend the draft, re-execute the instrument at the same protocol, and re-obtain the certified testimonio without re-payment of the full professional fee for ministerial corrections.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inscription of the Corporation in the Panamanian Mercantile Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá - Sección de Registro Mercantil (Mercantile Registration department)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized first testimonio of the Escritura Pública together with proof of payment of stamp taxes and registry tariffs. The Registry will perform a name search, verify the legality of the clauses, and electronically or physically inscribe the corporation with a folio number. Upon completion, request a certified copy of the inscription and a certificate of corporate existence and appointment of officers.
required_dossiers: Notarized primer testimonio of the Escritura Pública de Constitución
Receipts for payment of municipal stamp tax and registry registration fees
Corporate name availability / search certificate (certificado de búsqueda)
List of directors and officers with passport copies
Registered agent details and acceptance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues an 'observación' (query), the applying attorney must file corrective aclaraciones within the statutory term (usually 30 days). Substantive defects require execution of a protocolized addendum deed and re-presentation to the same Registry section.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Commercial License (Aviso de Operación) and Zoning Viability
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Alcaldía de Panamá - Dirección de Rentas Municipales (Municipal Revenue Office)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After obtaining the inscription certificate, apply for the Aviso de Operación with the Municipality of Panama. The Municipality verifies commercial zoning (uso de suelo), sanitary compatibility of the premises for grocery retail, and payment of the municipal operating fee. The license is then issued in the activity category for retail sale of foodstuffs and beverages.
required_dossiers: Certificado de inscripción from the Registro Público de Panamá
Aviso de Operación application form (solicitud)
Notarized lease agreement or property title for the store premises
Zoning / land-use certificate (certificado de uso de suelo) for the commercial address
Identification documents of the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Municipality denies the application due to unfavorable zoning, file an appeal before the Municipal Council or apply for a special commercial use authorization through the Urban Planning Department; alternatively select a compliant commercially zoned address and resubmit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Identification Number (RUC) and Taxpayer Registration with DGI
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) - Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (online portal and service windows)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the corporation's tax registration using the DGI electronic portal to obtain the RUC and register the taxable activities under ISIC 4721 (retail sale of food in specialized stores). Provide the corporate inscription certificate, municipal Aviso de Operación, deed copy, and representative's identity documents. The DGI will assign the taxpayer file number, invoice sequence authorization, and confirm obligations under Panama's territorial taxation regime.
required_dossiers: Certificado de inscripción del Registro Público de Panamá
Municipal Aviso de Operación
Certified copy of the Escritura Pública de Constitución
Passport or cédula of the legal representative
Proof of the registered business address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DGI flags the activity code, provide the ISIC 4721 description as stated in the Aviso de Operación and request reclassification; correct any discrepancy in the address or representative documentation and resubmit digitally.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Employer Registration with the Caja de Seguro Social (CSS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Caja de Seguro Social (CSS) - Dirección Nacional de Afiliación y Cuotas Obreras y Patronales
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the S.A. as an employer with CSS to become compliant for social security and educational insurance contributions. Submit the corporate inscription certificate, RUC, employer registration form, and initial payroll data for any founding employees. Obtain the employer quota account number required before hiring staff.
required_dossiers: Certificado de inscripción del Registro Público de Panamá
RUC certificate issued by DGI
Employer registration form (formulario de inscripción patronal)
Identity documents of the legal representative and initial employees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If CSS returns the file due to payroll or employee census discrepancies, correct the digital submission in the CSS employer portal and resubmit within the granted rectification period.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Alcaldía de Panamá (Municipality of Panama) and Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) - Dirección General de Comercio; sanitary supervision by Ministerio de Salud (MINSA)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia Comercial / Aviso de Operación for retail sale of imported Asian foodstuffs (ISIC 4721) and Permiso Sanitario de Funcionamiento issued by MINSA for food-handling premises

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) - Dirección de Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category III (low environmental impact) - Environmental Registration (Registro de Impacto Ambiental) is sufficient; a full EIA report is not mandated for a small-format supermarket retail operation lacking major industrial processes or significant effluent discharge.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Sanitary wastewater must meet national effluent limits for BOD5 (≤ 250 mg/L), COD (≤ 500 mg/L), total suspended solids (≤ 200 mg/L), and pH 6.0-9.0 before discharge to municipal sewers; kitchen and produce waste lines must be equipped with grease traps; refrigeration systems must be free of ozone-depleting refrigerants with periodic leakage inspection under Law 41 of 1998 and Panama's Montreal Protocol commitments; solid waste and expired-food handling must follow municipal collection contracts and MINSA disposal rules.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate (Visto Bueno del Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá) requiring fire extinguishers, emergency lighting, and an approved evacuation plan; structural load and electrical installation inspection approved by the Dirección de Ingeniería Municipal; MINSA food-handling hygiene clearance and food handler health cards; mandatory occupational health and safety measures, first-aid provisions, and CSS employer compliance before staff deployment.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF), Republic of Panama; taxpayer portal: SISTEMA TRIBUTARIO (sede electrónica at https://www.mef.gob.pa and https://sistematributario.mef.gob.pa)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the Sociedad Anónima by filing a 'pública escritura' (public deed) with the Registro Público de Panamá; a licensed resident agent is mandatory. Step 2: Obtain the municipal Aviso de Operación (business license) from the competent alcaldía (e.g., Municipio de Panamá) before commencing retail activity. Step 3: File the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente) application online through the DGI's SISTEMA TRIBUTARIO portal, attaching the corporate deed, municipal license, and identification of directors/officers; a foreign entity may obtain the RUC through its resident agent without local presence beyond its registered agent. Step 4: Update registrations for ITBMS status and receive DGI authorization to issue fiscal invoices (electronic invoicing profile). Step 5: Secure the sectoral sanitary permit from MINSA (Ministerio de Salud) for food retail premises; the DGI cross-references this permit in its registration and inspection database. For foreign-owned S.A. entities, the RUC process takes approximately 5-15 business days with a resident agent's apostilled powers of attorney.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation | Territorial_Scope: The Panamanian S.A. is a separate corporate taxpayer subject to corporate income tax (ISR) at 25% on the rate applied to net income sourced in Panamanian territory only; worldwide income of non-resident activities is outside Panamanian tax jurisdiction. Foreign shareholders are not taxed in Panama on distributions or capital gains generated abroad. No pass-through treatment applies to the S.A.; the entity cannot be treated as a disregarded hybrid for Panamanian purposes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election exists in Panamanian law. Available elections and regimes: (i) Pequeño Contribuyente (small taxpayer) optional regime for entities with annual gross income not exceeding B/.36,000, replacing ordinary ISR and ITBMS mechanics with a simplified fixed-rate quarterly tax; (ii) election to carry forward net operating losses under the revised ISR rules (subject to the statutory limitation periods); (iii) ITBMS input credit elections and accelerated recognition rules for capital goods; (iv) election to accrue income under the pre-2010 versus post-2010 territorial rules in limited transition scenarios. Hybrid mismatch elections are not available; Panama applies a purely territorial sourcing rule and has not adopted OECD hybrid arrangement rules or GAAR-style election forms.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS - Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios (VAT-equivalent tax on transfers of movable goods and services)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No monetary threshold for general registration: any person habitually carrying out taxable transfers of goods or rendering of services in Panama, including retail importers, must obtain an RUC and register for ITBMS regardless of turnover. A lower-tier alternative exists: taxpayers with annual gross income ≤ B/.36,000 may register as Pequeños Contribuyentes and apply the simplified fixed-rate regime instead of standard ITBMS filing and collection mechanics.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (facturación electrónica) applies progressively by taxpayer category; medium and large taxpayers must generate each Comprobante Fiscal Digital in the DGI-approved format, sign it with an X.509 digital certificate, and transmit the invoice file to the DGI's SISTEMA TRIBUTARIO platform for real-time validation. Only invoices receiving a DGI 'AUTORIZADO' status (or an approved contingency code in documented system failure) may be issued to customers. Invoice data must include the RUC, buyer identification, tax base, rate, and ITBMS amount, with unique sequential numbering. Small taxpayers may continue using fiscal printers or approved simplified receipts. Failure to transmit or obtain clearance is treated as issuing non-fiscal invoices and triggers daily fines and suspension of invoice authorization.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The 0% ITBMS rate applies to (i) physical export of Panamanian movable goods, and (ii) certain international services expressly classified as exports by DGI rulings, provided: (a) the seller is an ITBMS-registered taxpayer; (b) the goods physically leave Panamanian customs territory within the statutory period and are evidenced by a formal export declaration (DUI - Declaración Única de Aduanas); (c) the transaction is concluded with a non-resident buyer; and (d) the exporter retains full transport and payment evidence. For a supermarket engaged in domestic retail (ISIC 4721), over-the-counter sale of imported Asian condiments and vegetables is domestic taxable supply at 7%; zero-rating applies only if the groceries are resold and physically exported from Panama under customs control, or supplied to duty-free/zona franca end-customers in the customs regime.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: DUI - Declaración Única de Aduanas (customs export declaration approved and stamped by the Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas de Panamá)
Commercial invoice and detailed packing list
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / CMR transport document issued to the non-resident consignee
Signed export contract or purchase order evidencing sale to the non-resident buyer
Inward remittance certificate or SWIFT/MT103 proof of foreign exchange settlement
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The DGI and Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas jointly audit export zero-rating claims through documentary cross-checks against the electronic export declaration system, transport manifests, and banking records. Failure to substantiate physical exit or to demonstrate receipt of foreign proceeds within approximately 180 days results in retroactive reversal of the 0% rate, with the ITBMS becoming payable together with monthly recargo (default interest) of up to 1.5% per month and surcharges of up to 25% of the tax due. Wilful misrepresentation or use of false export documents triggers civil fines ranging from 50% to 200% of the evaded tax, suspension of the RUC and invoice authorization, and criminal liability for tax fraud under Ley 8 de 2010 and Código Fiscal Articles 708-712, with imprisonment available for serious cases. For the target retail operation, the principal indirect-tax exposure is instead the 7% ITBMS charged on importation at customs (creditable as input tax) and the 7% output tax on consumer sales.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco Nacional de Panamá (National Bank of Panama, fiscal agent) and Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (Superintendent of Banks); Panama has no conventional monetary central bank under the partially dollarized system.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama is de facto dollarized with the U.S. dollar as legal tender. Both current-account and capital-account transactions are fully convertible and free of exchange-control approval. Profit remittances encounter no FX conversion or central-bank permit hurdle; the practical limitations are derived solely from AML/CFT source-of-funds verification and bank-level business-risk screening.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Panamanian law imposes no mandatory surrender of export proceeds, no conversion ratio, and no prescribed holding timeline for export receipts. Export revenue may be retained in U.S. dollars, used directly for import settlement, or freely remitted, subject only to standard AML/CFT transaction reporting thresholds.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-medium feasibility. Panama does not license offshore digital EMIs as banks, and EMIs cannot lawfully accept deposits or participate directly in Panama's local clearing infrastructure. Offshore EMIs may be used as auxiliary payment-collection tools for card or tokenized flows, but all treasury liquidity must be consolidated and settled through a licensed Panamanian bank to preserve legal certainty and reporting traceability.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: SBP risk-based KYC regulations permit remote onboarding with video identification and certified electronic records for low-risk corporate accounts. In practice, tier-1 Panamanian banks usually require at least one physical meeting with the legal representative, director, or attorney-in-fact for account opening, signature verification, and digital-token issuance. A local Resident Agent can execute the physical step only when holding a valid notarial power-of-attorney.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque S.A. ownership or nominee-shareholder structure without traceable ultimate beneficial owner.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified share-registry extract, updated Register of Ultimate Beneficial Owner filing, notarized passport copies of shareholders and directors, bank reference letters, and a written confirmation that no bearer shares are outstanding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between declared grocery-retail turnover and observed transaction volumes or import values.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited or reviewed financial statements, ITBMS tax filings, customs import declarations (declaración de mercancías), supplier purchase orders and invoices, warehouse lease agreements, inventory records, and bank statements for the prior six months.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Counterparty or jurisdiction exposure to high-risk Asian jurisdictions in the imported-condiment supply chain.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full KYC file on each foreign supplier, commercial contract, original pro-forma invoice, cargo and insurance documentation, beneficial-owner registry extract or business-license certificate of the supplier, and a narrative explaining the ISIC 4721 specialty-grocery trade model.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid round-tripping or unusual cash-in/cash-out patterns inconsistent with a physical supermarket.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Projected cash-flow budget, POS sales reports, payroll records, landlord and utility contracts, supplier payment schedules, and strict non-cash settlement evidence for all international disbursements.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity or shareholder loans should be sent only through SWIFT MT103 or higher-quality correspondent clearing into the Panamanian bank's U.S. dollar correspondent account. The MT103 remittance-information field should state 'Paid-in Capital Increase' or 'Shareholder Loan', supported by a board resolution, updated stock ledger, notarized contribution certificate, and source-of-funds declaration. The bank will run OFAC/sanctions screening and UBO verification; no FX conversion or central-bank approval is required.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use standard USD clearing through New York Fedwire/CHIPS correspondent accounts for all cross-border trade payments. Open-account import settlements should be executed by SWIFT MT103; commercial letters of credit require MT700/MT707 issuance through the issuing Panamanian bank. For low-value supplier payments, documentary collection (DP/DA) may be used. Domestic operating payments may clear through Panama's local ACH/check-clearing system, but international treasury balances must always be moved via the correspondent-bank corridor.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forwards with licensed global dealing banks where settlement currency is convertible
Non-deliverable forwards (NDF) for restricted or high-volatility Asian currencies such as IDR or VND
Cross-currency swaps for non-USD financing or multi-currency import payables
Plain-vanilla FX options and zero-cost collars under ISDA master agreements
USD/Asian-currency commercial FX swaps executed offshore through an SBP-regulated counterparty

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Panama Ministry of Economy and Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 15 March of each calendar year; if the date falls on a weekend or official holiday, the deadline moves to the next business day
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment triggers a 10% surcharge plus statutory interest calculated on the overdue tax; prolonged non-payment can lead to suspension of corporate registration rights and eventual administrative strike-off by the Registro Público.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Declaration (Declaración Jurada de Renta)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Panama Ministry of Economy and Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By 15 March for S.A.s with a 31 December fiscal year-end; for a different fiscal year-end, within three months after the year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Tax Code imposes late-filing fines of approximately B/.25 to B/.500, plus interest and surcharges on any tax deficiency; continued noncompliance may result in tax liens, collection enforcement, and criminal fiscal action.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial-Owner Declaration Update and Annual Reconfirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Beneficial Ownership Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 15 calendar days after any transfer or change in ultimate beneficial ownership; annual confirmation must also be completed through the registered agent to maintain the registered beneficial-owner file current
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Noncompliance under Law 70 of 2019 can trigger administrative fines and suspension of the S.A.'s legal acts in Panama until the beneficial ownership information is rectified.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No universal statutory audit obligation applies to all private S.A.s. Independent audit is compulsory for entities listed on the Panama Stock Exchange, banks, insurers, regulated financial intermediaries, taxpayers classified as large taxpayers by DGI, and entities whose shareholders validly exercise inspection rights or whose creditor agreements require audited financial statements. DGI may also require audited statements for any taxpayer whenever it determines that the return, records, or books require external verification.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Panama; SMEs may apply IFRS for SMEs; regulated entities apply any supplementary accounting manual issued by their sector regulator.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Panamanian S.A. law requires the registered agent to maintain a secure, current beneficial-ownership register. Under Law 70 of 2019, any transfer of shares or change in control must be declared to the Registro Público within 15 calendar days. The annual confirmation is performed by the registered agent by reviewing the Register of Members, verifying the current UBO certificate, and updating the Registro Público's beneficial-ownership file as needed; the S.A. and its agents remain subject to inspection at any time.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Junta Directiva y Accionistas)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600 – 1,200 per year, depending on the corporate services provider, including registered agent services and registered office address
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000 – 6,000 for a mid-size grocery-store S.A., assuming a single location, standard inventory, and no related-party complexity

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial system taxes only Panamanian-source income; foreign-source trading profits are exempt subject to business-seat substance. Qualifying small taxpayers may use progressive rates from 5% to 20% on taxable income up to USD 150,000. No general tax holiday applies to grocery retail; standard deductions (COGS, rent, payroll, depreciation) and prepayment credits reduce the effective burden.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 100 – Declaración Anual de Renta de Personas Jurídicas, e-filed through the DGI en Línea / e-Tributos portal of the Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI-MEF).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 3 months after fiscal year-end (by 31 March for calendar-year taxpayers). Large taxpayers must also remit quarterly advance payments (anticipos) creditable against the annual return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue from Panamanian-source retail sales of Asian specialty grocery products before any deductions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include only Panamanian-source receipts; exclude foreign-source trading income supported by substance documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income from exempt sources, including foreign-source revenue qualifying under the territorial rule.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach evidence of foreign-source character and business seat (sede de explotación) maintained in Panama.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of goods sold, including import costs of Asian condiments, vegetables, freight, and customs duties.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure intercompany purchase pricing complies with the arm's length standard if suppliers are related parties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Rent, payroll, utilities, depreciation, marketing, insurance, and other deductible operating expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductible only if incurred to produce taxable Panamanian-source income and supported by valid invoices.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after COGS, operating expenses, and admissible adjustments, before net operating loss application.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the 5-year loss carryforward in chronological order with supporting schedules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax computed at 25% on net taxable income, or at the progressive 5%-20% scale for qualifying small taxpayers.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute liability at entity level only; do not include shareholders' personal circumstances.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Advance tax payments, foreign tax credits, and other withholding credits available to offset the computed tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile DGI receipts for prepayments; carry forward unused credits with formal DGI authorization.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 8 (Impuesto a pagar / saldo a favor)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final net tax due to DGI or refundable balance.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Settle through DGI e-payment channels before the statutory deadline; refunds require post-audit approval.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: fine of 10% of the tax due (minimum USD 100, maximum USD 500) plus moratory interest of 1.5% per month or fraction; false or fraudulent returns trigger criminal tax evasion sanctions.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final withholding tax on gross dividends paid by a Panamanian Sociedad Anónima; the tax is withheld by the company and constitutes a final liability of the shareholder, without imputation credit for the 25% corporate tax paid.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Panama has a limited treaty network (e.g., UK, Mexico, Korea, Singapore, France, Portugal, Barbados). To claim a reduced rate, the non-resident beneficial owner must: (1) obtain an apostilled Certificate of Tax Residency (TRC) from its home jurisdiction; (2) deliver the TRC and a beneficial-ownership declaration to the paying S.A.; (3) file the DGI treaty-relief form through the e-Tributos portal before the distribution; and (4) retain the approved file for 5 years. Excess WHT may be recovered through the devolución procedure.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties, technical services, and IP license fees paid to non-residents: 12.5% statutory WHT. Interest paid to non-residents: 6% statutory WHT (certain international bank financing exemptions apply). Applicable DTA rates are available only after the TRC procedure described above.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File and TP informational return (Formulario Nota Técnica) triggered when related-party transactions exceed USD 250,000 (B/.250,000) in a fiscal year; Master File and Country-by-Country notification apply to multinational groups with consolidated annual revenue of at least USD 85 million.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Economic Substance Regulations (Law 70 of 2019 and Executive Decree 352 of 2019) apply to relevant activities, including distribution and service centers, financing, headquarters, insurance, IP holding, shipping, and pure equity holding. Domestic grocery retail itself is not a listed relevant activity; however, intra-group procurement and distribution performed within the Asian supermarket chain will qualify as a distribution and service center and demands management and control in Panama, local employees, premises, and expenditure commensurate with income. Reliance on the territorial exemption for foreign-source income also requires maintaining the business seat (sede de explotación) in Panama.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intentional omission of cash sales from Formulario 100, use of inflated intercompany invoices, fictitious deductions, or destruction of accounting records.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment of 3 to 6 years under the Criminal Code when the evaded tax exceeds USD 100,000, plus a fine of up to 100% of the omitted tax and moratory interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Signing directors and legal representatives are jointly and severally liable; DGI may obtain asset freezes, preventive seizures, and travel bans (arraigo) against the individuals.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the S.A. as an invoice-switching or asset-holding conduit with no physical office, no employees, no books, or no resident agent; failing the ESR substance test for a relevant group activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to USD 1,000,000 under the ESR regime, administrative strike-off or dissolution, and loss of the territorial exemption for foreign-source income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be fined individually for false ESR filings; courts may lift the corporate veil where the entity is used for fraud, exposing shareholders and officers to civil restitution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Structuring cash receipts, processing third-party fund transfers through the grocery's bank accounts, or accepting suspicious cash without internal controls and SAR reporting under Law 23 of 2015.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal money-laundering penalties of 5 to 12 years' imprisonment, aggravated to up to 15 years when the laundered amount exceeds USD 1 million; confiscation of proceeds and corporate fines.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts routinely pierce the corporate veil in AML cases; directors face personal imprisonment, civil confiscation of assets, and a 10-year prohibition from holding commercial positions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deducting employee income tax at source or the 10% dividend WHT and failing to remit the exact amount to DGI within statutory deadlines.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine of 10% of the unremitted amount plus 1.5% monthly moratory interest; criminal misappropriation charges for deliberate non-remittance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: DGI enforces joint and several collection against directors and payroll officers; travel bans and bank garnishments are ordered for persistent defaulters.
